target_strategy.main_angle: Position Denys Strakhov as a backend-first Node.js/TypeScript full-stack developer for Galaktica's approximately 70% backend role. The three strongest supporting arguments are: 1) commercial Node.js/TypeScript backend and React/Next.js delivery on the EPAM large-scale multi-locale e-commerce platform, supported by Case 7; 2) integration and operational reliability experience from the ProductsUp, Amplience, CommerceTools and customer notification cases, supported by Cases 1–4 and 8; 3) strong relational database, migrations and data-integrity experience from the Factor–IT financial accounting system, supported by Case 5.
risk_mitigation: Do not claim commercial NestJS experience; show NestJS through the current JobFlow personal portfolio project.
Do not claim MySQL experience; use confirmed PostgreSQL schema, SQL, migrations, transactions and data-integrity evidence as transferable database experience.
Do not claim BullMQ, Sentry, Grafana, CRM, advertising-platform, UTM analytics or commercial marketing-automation ownership.
Frame external API experience through confirmed Amplience, CommerceTools and ProductsUp integrations rather than marketing-specific platforms.
Keep React visible as production full-stack contribution while maintaining backend-first positioning.
Use the mandatory current-work block to show continued development after relocation while keeping EPAM dominant.
Present CI/CD and Docker as participation or local/personal experience rather than ownership of production infrastructure.

cv_content.headline: Backend-focused Full Stack Developer | Node.js | TypeScript | React | REST APIs
summary: Backend-focused Full Stack Developer with commercial Node.js and TypeScript experience across production backend services, REST/API integrations, Azure serverless workflows and large-scale e-commerce.
Production React/Next.js contribution includes components, PDP and related-product features, BFF/API integration and frontend-backend debugging.
Relevant integration cases include ProductsUp synchronization, Amplience webhook automation and CommerceTools product-data flows, with retries, idempotency, batching and production investigation.
Strong PostgreSQL foundation from production financial systems, including schema work, complex SQL, migrations, transactions and data integrity.
Based in Cologne, Germany; authorized to work in Germany and open to remote or Cologne-based collaboration.

current_work_block.role_line: Freelance Software Development, Backend Portfolio Projects & Relocation
current_work_block.stable_intro: After relocating from Ukraine to Germany, continued working on small freelance tasks, backend-focused portfolio projects, self-directed backend learning, and local volunteering.

bullets.text: Supported small Node.js/React improvements on an independent basis, including feature additions, bug fixes, API-related changes, UI adjustments and maintenance tasks.

Built JobFlow CV Pipeline, a backend-first NestJS/TypeScript portfolio project with modular service boundaries, PostgreSQL/Prisma persistence, Swagger/OpenAPI documentation and deterministic PDF export.
Continued Python/FastAPI backend learning through personal projects using PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Pytest, Docker, OpenAI API and GitHub Actions.
Volunteered as IT Technician at HEY, ALTER! Köln e.V., refurbishing donated laptops for school students in Cologne.

Worked on a large-scale multi-locale e-commerce platform for a major European retailer, delivering backend and fullstack features across product data, content workflows, integrations, BFF/API layers and scheduled jobs.
Built and maintained production backend services using Node.js, TypeScript and Azure Functions, including HTTP, scheduled and queue/topic/subscription-triggered workflows.

Built the initial implementation and later maintained/contributed to a ProductsUp synchronization flow processing approximately 20,000–40,000 products per sync, with Azure Durable Functions, CommerceTools enrichment, Azure Blob Storage, Stream API uploads, retries, idempotency, failed-product logging and per-locale result summaries.

Automated selected Amplience CMS workflows using webhook-based Azure Functions, handling create, update, publish and unpublish events, validation, logging, retries, cache updates and mass field updates that could affect tens to hundreds of entities or pages.

Integrated CommerceTools product data into PDP, listing, BFF/backend and ProductsUp enrichment flows, handling filters, product groups, 50+ attributes, optional fields, pagination where supported and custom batching where needed for a catalog of up to approximately 100,000 unique products.
Contributed to production React/Next.js features as a backend-focused fullstack developer, including components, PDP changes, related-product features and frontend-to-backend API integration.

Investigated production issues using Azure Application Insights and KQL, tracing failures across Azure Functions and backend services and contributing to additional logging and alerting for a business-critical customer notification flow.

Wrote and maintained backend unit tests with Jest, worked within SonarQube quality gates and participated in Azure DevOps release, deploy and redeploy processes, code review, documentation and knowledge transfer.

Developed backend functionality for a production public-sector budget accounting system, focusing on PostgreSQL-heavy features, complex business logic, financial data integrity and legacy backend maintenance.
Planned and executed high-risk PostgreSQL migrations for financial accounting data, including multi-table account-splitting changes, transactions, validation and rollback planning where possible.
Wrote complex SQL queries using joins, subqueries and indexes, and worked on query optimization and data-integrity improvements.
Contributed to a custom in-house PHP backend framework, improving database access, migration tooling, validation, permissions and backend routing.

Completed a full-time Node.js transition internship focused on moving from PHP backend development to JavaScript backend development, covering REST APIs, Express, NestJS basics, MongoDB, Docker basics and code review.
